titleTag: Pack, sell most of it, then repack what's left into a smaller tub.

captions.text: Sign in, start with a small delivery
Pack it all into a small spare tub
Sell every bit of it — that tub is now empty
A full 10kg delivery comes in next
Sell most of it — a little left over
Repack the dregs into that empty spare tub from earlier

closeTag: A container only ever exists already-filled — an empty tub has to be earned by selling one out.
